pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 8.3.1 WORD CLASSES: SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we show where a person or thing is?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly
2. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly
   In simple words: practise until you can use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions.
4. Show that you can: identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Word Classes: Simple prepositions important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using prepositions of position, place and time and display on charts,
2. Fill in gaps in given sentences using of prepositions of position, time and place,
3. Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner builds on their knowledge of simple prepositions to express themselves clearly.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we show where a person or thing is?
2. How do you show the position of a thing or the time something happens?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify prepositions of position, time and place correctly
2. use prepositions of position, time and place in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
